= Tables: Headers and Cell Formatters

== Inferred header (blank line after first row)

|===
| Name | Role | Location

| Alice | Engineer | Remote
| Bob | Designer | Office
|===

== Explicit header via [%header]

[%header]
|===
| Item | Price | Stock
| Apple | 1 | 12
| Pear | 2 | 7
|===

== Cell formatters

[cols="1,1,1,1"]
|===
| plain s| strong cell e| emphasised cell | trailing
| also plain m| monospace text l| literal *not strong* h| forced th in body row
|===
